hints.title: Traverse in Reverse
hints.text: Iterate through the array backwards from right to left while maintaining the maximum element encountered so far.

hints.title: Update In Place
hints.text: For element arr[i], its replacement is the running maximum of elements to its right. Then update running max with original arr[i].

hints.title: Initialize with Negative One
hints.text: Initialize max_val = -1; traverse backwards, swap temp = arr[i], arr[i] = max_val, max_val = max(max_val, temp).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning to the right for every index takes quadratic time O(N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single backward pass maintains running maximum in constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate immediately recognizes backward iteration replaces repeated linear searches.
complexity.notes: Modifies the array in place with O(1) auxiliary space.
